i1.note: The filing says Whirlpool deconsolidated Whirlpool India in Q4 2025 after losing a controlling financial interest.

i2.note: The filing says ownership fell from 51% to approximately 40%.

i4.note: The filing describes a retained investment with basis difference and equity method goodwill, consistent with an equity-method interest of about 40%, not a controlled subsidiary.

i5.note: The Exhibit 21 excerpts show Whirlpool India Holdings Limited and Whirlpool Asia LLP but no Whirlpool of India Limited, consistent with deconsolidation.

i6.note: The filing gives $599 million fair value of the retained interest (Level 1) and $166 million of sale proceeds.

i7.note: The 10-K confirms the Feb 2024 market sale cut ownership from 75% to 51%. It is background on a stake that has since fallen to about 40%.

i8.note: The 10-K says MDA Asia is no longer reported as a segment because Whirlpool India was deconsolidated.

i9.note: The filing says Whirlpool India holds 100% of Elica PB India and that it was deconsolidated in the transaction. This is a former subsidiary, not a current one.

b1.note: The 10-K says that in April 2024 the MENA business was sold and the European MDA business was contributed to Beko Europe.

b2.note: The 25% stake was agreed to be sold in June 2026 and the Q3 2026 table shows 0% ownership, so the present-tense claim is stale. The $186M fair value and 15.5% rate are not in the passages.

b3.note: The Q3 2026 10-Q confirms the June 2026 agreement with Arcelik to sell the remaining 25% of Beko Europe.

b4.note: Beko Europe is not a subsidiary and is not on Exhibit 21. But 'Whirlpool owns part of it' is out of date, because the stake was sold in June 2026 and the Q3 2026 table shows 0% ownership.

b5.note: The 10-K calls Whirlpool India, Beko Europe and Whirlpool China minority holdings. They are equity-method investments, and Exhibit 21 does not list them as subsidiaries.

o1.note: The Q3 2026 10-Q repeats the intent to evaluate all options to reduce debt throughout 2026. The roster implication is an inference.

o2.note: The Q1 2026 10-Q says net sales fell 9.6% for the reasons stated. It is a stale quarter and not about subsidiaries.

o4.note: The Q1 2026 10-Q exhibit list shows no subsidiary list, which is consistent with Exhibit 21 appearing only in the annual 10-K.

c3.note: I counted 118 entity rows in the saved Exhibit 21 table, excluding header and separator rows.

c4.note: The list has 118 rows, not roughly 117. The count is close, but the claim understates it by one.
